config.data: Four original discovery country pairs, two endpoints, two tasks and two templates. Familiar source vocabulary; capital-task challenge, not sealed test. No outcome filtering.
config.frozen: H1023 package unchanged. Test same lexical payload under native task routing, plus separately frozen language routing. Head4 is predeclared alternative cached-slot control, not equal-price learned model.
config.gate: Per template both-endpoint accuracy>=.75 and intended full-vocabularytop1>=.5; all failures retained.
config.metrics: Aligned recovery of full natural country-swap margin effect; replay and fixed-routing errors relative to isolated cachedhead0path.
